page_title: AST 3-2 BUR | Aston Villa v Burnley 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Flag goes up against Connor Roberts (Burnley) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+8' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to John McGinn (Aston Villa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+8' John McGinn (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Burnley.
90+7' The linesman signals that Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+6' The expression of the referee Stuart Attwell is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is shown a yellow card.
90+3' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa) replaces Leon Bailey.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 2 Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) gave the goalkeeper no chance from the penalty. James Trafford failed to reach the ball, which slid off the crossbar into the roof of the net.
89' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Yellow card! It's like Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Stuart Attwell agrees and books him.
87' Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Aston Villa! Let's see who will take responsibility.
86' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is able to continue to play.
84' John McGinn (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
82' The resulting corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared.
82' Substitution. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Moussa Diaby walks off.
79' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by John McGinn (Aston Villa) but poses no threat.

79' John McGinn (Aston Villa) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
77' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
74' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Johann Berg Gudmundsson will be replaced by Connor Roberts (Burnley).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) comes onto the pitch for Wilson Odobert.
71' 2 - 2 Lyle Foster (Burnley) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Emiliano Martinez with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
70' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
69' A mistake by a defender gifts Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
68' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
67' The linesman raises his flag. Lyle Foster (Burnley) is adjudged offside.
64' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
64' John McGinn (Aston Villa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but James Trafford easily deals with the threat.
62' It's time for a substitution. Pau Torres (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Clement Lenglet.
61' Lyle Foster (Burnley) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
59' Today's match ends for Zeki Amdouni who will be replaced by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley).

58' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
58' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
56' Sander Berge (Burnley) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
53' Half-chance! Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) plays a pass into the box, but James Trafford reacts well to snuff out the attack.
51' Lyle Foster (Burnley) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Aston Villa, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
51' Vitinho (Burnley) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
49' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
49' A snap shot by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Emiliano Martinez produces a good save to thwart him.
48' Lyle Foster (Burnley) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' The resulting corner from Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) comes to nothing.
45+4' Rough tackle by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' Lyle Foster (Burnley) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Emiliano Martinez easily deals with the threat.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
42' Sander Berge (Burnley) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Stuart Attwell lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.

42' 2 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins displays great vision and sends a pass to Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
42' The ball is cleared after Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
40' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
39' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
37' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lyle Foster (Burnley) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
34' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick to Aston Villa.
30' 1 - 1 Goal! Dara O'Shea puts the ball on a plate for Zeki Amdouni (Burnley), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:1.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Ollie Watkins, then sends the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
28' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Emiliano Martinez has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
26' That was close. Josh Brownhill (Burnley) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
25' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
25' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
24' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
23' A yellow card for a tackle by Charlie Taylor (Burnley). Stuart Attwell doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
23' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

22' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
21' Lyle Foster (Burnley) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Aston Villa are awarded the free kick.
20' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
18' The main referee, Stuart Attwell, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) is given a yellow card for dissent.
18' John McGinn (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
17' Vincent Kompany is forced to make a change. Jordan Beyer (Burnley) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Hannes Delcroix.
16' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but James Trafford pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
11' John McGinn (Aston Villa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals. Burnley are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
11' Sander Berge (Burnley) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
9' Flag up against Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Burnley have a free kick.
6' John McGinn (Aston Villa) tries to find Ollie Watkins, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
3' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
3' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Aston Villa will take the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
